faqs.q: What is Potion and how does it work?
faqs.a: Potion is an advanced video generation AI. It allows you to create AI personalized videos in your own face and voice at scale. The AI technology learns how you speak, emote, and gesture when you talk and then creates videos on your behalf. Potion videos are proven to reduce effort in video creation and enhance engagement on sales and marketing campaigns.

faqs.q: What is the difference between self-recorded and AI-generated videos in Potion?
faqs.a: Self-recorded videos allow you to personally create video content, adding a human touch to your outreach. AI-generated videos, on the other hand, use text input to create videos automatically with your face & voice, enabling you to scale your video production without needing to record each one individually. Both options can be personalized, depending on your outreach strategy.

faqs.q: Is Potion easy to use?
faqs.a: Absolutely! Potion's user-friendly interface allows you to easily generate perosnalized AI videos, just by typing in a video script. No technical knowledge is required. You can quickly generate videos that leave a lasting impression on your audience.

faqs.q: Why is Potion different from other AI video tools?
faqs.a: Our unique AI video software and its personalization goes beyond simple visual generations. You can tailor each video's content to your audience's specific needs, making it feel like a genuine one-on-one interaction. Potion integrations, scalability, and ease of use make it a powerful choice for B2B sales, marketing, and customer success professionals.

faqs.q: Is Potion Suitable for My Business?
faqs.a: Potion is ideal for a wide range of businesses. This includes sales teams, marketing professionals, entrepreneurs, support teams, and anyone looking to connect with their audience through AI video personalization. If you're seeking to increase engagement and conversion rates, Potion's Al-powered video personalization software is an excellent fit.

faqs.q: Are the gestures synced with the audio in the video?
faqs.a: Yes, we synchronize gestures with the audio in your video, ensuring that the avatar’s movements are in harmony with the speech. This synchronization helps create a more cohesive and engaging viewer experience.

faqs.q: How accurate is the lip-syncing in Potion's AI-generated videos?
faqs.a: Our technology ensures highly accurate lip-syncing by precisely matching the movement of the avatar's lips with the audio. This creates a natural and realistic speaking experience. Thereby, making the videos more engaging and convincing for the viewer.

faqs.q: Which tools does Potion integrate with?
faqs.a: Potion integrates with 50+ sales, marketing, support, and CRM tools. You can find the entire list on our integrations page.

faqs.q: How many languages does Potion support?
faqs.a: Potion supports 29 most commonly spoken languages in the world - English (USA), English (UK), English (Australia), English (Canada), Japanese, Chinese, German, Hindi, French (France), French (Canada), Korean, Portuguese (Brazil), Portuguese (Portugal), Italian, Spanish (Spain), Spanish (Mexico), Indonesian, Dutch, Turkish, Filipino, Polish, Swedish, Bulgarian, Romanian, Arabic (Saudi Arabia), Arabic (UAE), Czech, Greek, Finnish, Croatian, Malay, Slovak, Danish, Tamil, Ukrainian, Russian.

sections.heading: Protecting Your Privacy
sections.text: At Potion, we understand the profound impact AI technology has on the future of communication, and with this power comes great responsibility. As pioneers in AI-generated personalized videos, we are committed to ensuring the ethical use of our technology. This includes (but is not limited to) safeguarding user identities, and promoting transparency and accountability across all interactions.

sections.heading: Safeguarding Against Identity Theft
sections.text: Our AI is designed to create hyper-realistic digital avatars, mimicking your face, voice, and gestures. While this presents immense possibilities, it also requires stringent safeguards to protect against identity theft or misuse. We have implemented several layers of security to ensure that your personal data and digital identity remain protected at all times.

sections.heading: Consent-Driven Processes
sections.text: We believe that you should have full control over your digital avatar. Potion’s AI video generation only proceeds after implicit user consent is obtained. Which means, you can only record videos using your web camera. This ensures that your likeness is never used without your permission.

sections.heading: Data Encryption
sections.text: All user data, including video recordings and personal information, is encrypted using industry-leading standards. We employ bank-grade TLS 1.2 encryption for data in transit and secure storage for all sensitive information.

sections.heading: Avoiding Deepfake Misuse
sections.text: We explicitly prohibit the use of Potion’s AI for creating deceptive or harmful content. While our AI is designed to mimic your authentic voice and face, we ensure its use is limited to legitimate, constructive purposes such as enhancing customer engagement, sales, and personalized communication. Misuse of the technology for malicious purposes like deepfake creation is against our policies and terms of service.

sections.heading: Continuous AI Monitoring
sections.text: To ensure that our AI models are not evolving into biased or unethical patterns, we consistently monitor and refine our technology. This process ensures that our AI remains fair, balanced, and respectful of diversity in every interaction.

sections.heading: Transparency in Communication
sections.text: When AI-generated videos are used, Potion encourages transparency. We make it easy for users to inform their audience that the video they are watching is AI-generated. This ensures that there is no confusion or misrepresentation about the content’s origin.

sections.heading: Ethical Marketing Practices
sections.text: We encourage businesses and individuals to use AI videos in ways that respect consumer privacy and data rights. Whether it's for marketing, sales, or customer service, we advocate for ethical outreach—focused on building trust, fostering engagement, and avoiding exploitation.

sections.heading: Promoting Culture of Ethics
sections.text: Potion is proud to be at the forefront of AI innovation, but we understand the importance of doing so responsibly. We actively promote a culture of ethical AI use both within our company and among our users, partners, and developers. Our goal is to ensure that AI not only serves business objectives but also adheres to high ethical standards.

sections.heading: Upholding the Principles
sections.text: By upholding these principles, we aim to build a future where AI-driven communication is secure, ethical, and empowers users without compromising their privacy or trust. As AI continues to evolve, Potion remains committed to leading with integrity. Thus, protecting our users' identities, and promoting responsible use of AI technology.

faqs.q: What is AI video prospecting, and how does it benefit my sales outreach?
faqs.a: AI video prospecting involves using artificial intelligence to create personalized video messaging tailored to each prospect. This approach enhances your sales outreach by making your messages more engaging and relevant. Further leading to higher response rates and better connections with potential customers. You can either self record then personalize or use our text to video generation feature.

faqs.q: How does Potion improve the efficiency of my sales team?
faqs.a: Our cold outreach AI software streamlines the process of creating and distributing personalized video content. Thereby, reducing the time and effort required for manual sales outreach. This allows your sales team to focus more on closing deals and less on administrative tasks. Ultimately, improving productivity and efficiency.

faqs.q: How do gestures impact the viewer’s perception of my video?
faqs.a: Gestures in AI video sales add a layer of expressiveness and engagement to your video. Thus, making it more memorable and relatable for the viewer. This can lead to a stronger connection with your audience, higher engagement rates, and improved overall effectiveness of your AI video prospecting outreach.

faqs.q: Can I have multiple video backgrounds in my Potion video?
faqs.a: Yes, our sales video software allows you to use multiple video backgrounds within a single video. This feature lets you seamlessly transition between different settings or themes. Thus, making your videos more dynamic and visually engaging. Whether you want to highlight different products, showcase various locations, or simply add a creative touch. Our multiple backgrounds functionality helps you tailor each part of your message to resonate more effectively with your audience.

faqs.q: Cold emails seem easier. Isn't prospecting with video too time-consuming?
faqs.a: While creating compelling videos takes some effort, the payoff can be significant. Think of it as an investment. Videos can save time in the long run by increasing response rates and shortening sales cycles. Plus, many user-friendly video creation tools exist to streamline the process. If you want to explore more, read this insightful article on cold emails vs video prospecting.

faqs.q: Can I integrate video prospecting with my existing cold email campaigns?
faqs.a: Yes! Mention your video in your email and create a sense of intrigue. Offer it as a valuable resource that provides more in-depth information. This can significantly boost your email open rates and click-through rates. Bonus Tip: No matter which method you choose, personalization is key. Tailor your outreach, whether through email or video, to your prospects' specific needs and interests. This increases the chance of sparking a genuine conversation and closing the deal.

faqs.q: Should I use a script for my prospecting videos?
faqs.a: Scripting can help you stay on track and ensure key points are covered. However, avoid sounding robotic. Practice delivering naturally and injecting your personality. Consider using a teleprompter for a polished yet conversational feel. Here are a few video prospecting scripts if you need some inspiration.

SOC2 compliant
Potion is SOC 2 TYPE 1 compliant, meaning Potion’s products and infrastructure undergoes a SOC 2 TYPE 1 audit which is performed by an independent third-party auditor.
Credit Card data safety
Credit card data is handled by Stripe, which stores your sensitive data on PCI-Compliant servers. Our servers and databases do not store any credit card information.
Secure & Reliable infrastructure
Potion uses AWS (Amazon Web Services) for hosting and serving your data. AWS is compliant with industry standards such as SOC1, SOC 2, SOC 3, ISO 27001, and HIPAA.
Outage recovery
Our Business continuity & disaster recovery plan ensures back up of all assets to guarantee the possibility of a recovery in case of disaster. All our backups are encrypted.
Data encryption
Data is encrypted in-transit using TLS 1.2 (Transport Layer Security), the safest method that is a widely accepted standard used by devices.

faqs.q: Can I reuse templates for future video campaigns?
faqs.a: Yes, Potion allows you to save and reuse video templates. This makes it easy to replicate successful campaigns or quickly create new videos based on proven formats.

faqs.q: Can I create videos for time-sensitive campaigns?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Potion’s rapid video generation capabilities make it ideal for creating custom AI videos for time-sensitive campaigns like seasonal promotions, flash sales, or event reminders. Best part? You never need to step in front of the camera — all you need is a text script and Potion does the rest.

sections.heading: Our values
sections.text: What we live by

sections.heading: Help them win
sections.text: Our core mission is clear - We exist to help sales teams win. This is our North Star. How do we do that? By crafting awesomely useful and beautiful AI products, that help them do more business. We can emphasize with our customers only when we help them win, and truly understand their needs more than any other company. "Help them win" also means help your teammate win at their job. They are in the trenches with you. Go out of your way to help them with anything they may need.

sections.heading: Be sincere
sections.text: Sincerity is being honest and respectful. We do that with each other and we do that with our customers. If you drop the ball, that's okay. Be honest about it. If someone else is dropping the ball, that's okay too. Have an honest conversation with them and if it coming from a place of sincerity, we will take that as constructive feedback.

sections.heading: Make mistakes
sections.text: It's important to recognize that everyone makes mistakes. And everyone means everyone. Fortunately in our world, almost all mistakes are fixable. So don't be afraid to make mistakes. The only thing we ask you is learn from them fast and move on fast.

sections.heading: Breathe
sections.text: If you feel overwhelmed, take a deep breath. Focus and simplify your work. In order to do a great job, we must take a step back, breathe, focus on what's really important for the customer, and eliminate everything that is unimportant. If you catch yourself thinking too much about deciding between two things, just go with your gut and move to the next decision.

sections.heading: Have fun
sections.text: Celebrate your wins, big or small. Recognize each others accomplishments. At the end of the day all that matters is that we can tell our friends, family, kids, what we are doing is actually pretty awesome. That we draw fulfillment, pride, and joy from our work. We've learned that this sense of fun and fulfillment doesn't come from “what products we are building” or “what industry we work in”. But from how we treat each other and how we treat our customers. So, have some fun while you're at it. It'll make your day easier. :)
